tools.name: RTutor
tools.description:
RTutor is an innovative developer tool that utilizes AI to generate and test R code. With the power of OpenAI's Davinci, RTutor can translate natural language into R scripts, which can be executed within the Shiny platform. This tool is perfect for developers who want to streamline their workflow and save time. 

## Key Features
- AI-powered R code generation and testing
- Integration with Shiny platform
- Ability to generate R Markdown source file and HTML report

## Main Use Case
1. A data analyst needs to quickly generate R code for a project. With RTutor, they can simply input their desired code in natural language and let the AI do the rest. This saves time and allows for more efficient workflow.
2. A developer wants to test their R code before implementing it. RTutor's testing capabilities allow for easy debugging and optimization of code.
3. A team of developers is working on a project and needs to collaborate on R code. RTutor's ability to generate R Markdown source files and HTML reports makes it easy to share and collaborate on code.
